plate_assignment_check.notes: Checked the present valid polygons for approximate Sousa and Koum region markers. The renderer reuses the vetted plate IDs, not an arbitrary shift of modern coastlines.

point_basis: Passagem das Pedras geosite at the published SGB point; the two-country study concerns broader regions, not distances between individual fossil outlines.
Koum region at the centre of the basin bounds in Menkem et al. (2026), fig. 1; this is not the exact KB-17 specimen locality.
citation: Kocsis, A. T. and Scotese, C. R. (2021), Mapping paleocoastlines and continental flooding during the Phanerozoic, Earth-Science Reviews 213, 103463. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.earscirev.2020.103463. PaleoCoastlines CC BY 4.0, modified for this board.
